summary.text: David Sinclair is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 50 since November 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney from Bath, he previously served on the Bath City Council.

paragraphs.text: David Sinclair was born in Maine and lives in Bath, Maine.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Brandeis University and a J.D. from the University of Maine School of Law, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Sinclair was an elected member of the Bath City Council from 2008 to 2014.
He assumed office in the Maine House in November 2023 and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
